task.title: Third party warning letter and unclassified violation

step.cmd: In FTS, using the third party’s SIN, select the Violation (ML01) transaction and input the violation as follows:

ul.li: Action: Select Add .
Notification week: Select the current w/c.
BPC: Type “8888.”
Imposed by: Select 1 - Agent .
Warning letter: Select 1 - Violation/warning letter issued .
Click Update .

step.cmd: Determine who is responsible for the net OP:

ul.li: If the third party is responsible for the net OP, go to step 12.
If the client is responsible for the net OP, go to step 14.

step.cmd: In FTS, using the client’s SIN, select the Renewal/Revised (M106) transaction to create an Operational Centre Memo (MM06) as follows:

ul.li: Registration number: Select the applicable registration number.
Memo (MPS): Check the box.
Contentious: Select 2 - Yes .
Complete: Select D - No .
Infraction: Select Z - Fraud - Other .
Message: Select 33 - Discrepancy in earnings due to Employment Insurance post audit .
Click Update .

step.cmd: When the Operational Centre Memo (MM06) transaction opens, send the information to IPOC as follows:

ul.li: BPC: Select the appropriate BPC.
Work item: Select 93 - Manual Pay System .
Work type: Select 35 - Claim cancellation .
Remarks line 1: Type “Third party OP. Adjust client’s file.”
Remarks line 2: Type “[OP amount] OP established under third party [third party’s SIN] on [date].”
Remarks line 3: Type “Third party OP established for [w/c for which the OP was established].”
Remarks line 4: Type “Issue amended T4E if required. Issue manual T4E to third party.”
Remarks line 5: Enter your first name and last name.
Contentious: Select 2 - Yes .
Complete: Select C - Yes .
Click Update .

step.cmd: In ACS, create and send the T-02-00-00 letter to advise the third party of the decision. Based on the claim information, select all of the required attributes, including the following:

ul.li: Third Party penalty/warning (2770): Select the appropriate option.
Following / In addition (2771): Select Following .
Claimant First Name (1044)
Claimant Last Name (1046)
Text - Indicate what the third party claim or declaration was (1696)
Text - Indicate what the third party claim or declaration should have been (1698)
Monetary penalty/warning message (2772): Select Warning message issued .
Violation Message to Third Party (2774): Select Violation Message to Third Party .

step.cmd: In NIIS, using the client’s SIN, on the Decision tab of the Report of Investigation (IC50 or IC70) screen, clear the case as follows:

ul.li:
Disentitlement: Select Yes or No .
Reason: Select the appropriate option, if applicable.

Overpayment: Select OP .
Amount: Enter the OP amount established for the client.

Penalty: Do one of the following:
If a penalty is imposed on the client, select Yes and enter the penalty amount in the Amount field.
If a penalty is not imposed on the client, select No .

Warning: Select Yes .
Reason: Select Other and do one of the following:
If a warning is issued to the third party only, type “Warning issued to the third party [third party’s name and SIN].”
If a warning is issued to the client and the third party, type “Warning issued to both client and third party [third party’s name and SIN].”

Violation: Select Yes and do one of the following:
If an unclassified violation is imposed on the third party only , select Warning and type “Unclassified violation imposed on third party [name and SIN of the third party] only.”
If an unclassified violation is imposed on both the client and the third party, select Warning for the client and in the space provided, type “Unclassified violation also imposed on third party [third party’s name and SIN].”

step.cmd: In NWS, complete the CR WI for the Integrity case.
